subject.title: improve(android): make Wear store releases reproducible

question: Should existing Android phone version codes with suffixes 50–99 be grandfathered or migrated before the new 01–49 allocation rule is enforced for release tooling?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes a release identity contract, but the diff does not establish whether already-valid published or pinned values must remain usable, be normalized, or be rejected with a supported migration path.

options.title: Add an explicit upgrade path
options.body: Preserve or narrowly migrate existing valid 50–99 phone values, then apply the 01–49 allocation rule only to newly chosen phone build numbers.

options.title: Adopt a breaking release policy
options.body: Reject existing 50–99 values and document the required operator migration before release commands can run.

options.title: Pause the allocation change
options.body: Land the reproducibility checks without narrowing the accepted phone version-code range until the durable policy is agreed.

recommendation.title: Add an explicit upgrade path
recommendation.body: Preserve or narrowly migrate existing valid 50–99 phone values, then apply the 01–49 allocation rule only to newly chosen phone build numbers.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged Wear companion implementation established the paired Android/Wear release boundary this PR changes.
